citations.excerpt: Discovery & Integration Design (1.5 weeks) -- API contract with order-management system, latency budget analysis.
Core Ledger Build (3 weeks) -- points award/redeem logic, ledger schema, audit trail.
FR-1: Award points on order completion (1 point per $1 spent, configurable rate). FR-2: Redeem points at checkout as a discount (max 50% of order value).

assumptions.description: Configurable point rate is a single global rate, not per-category.
assumptions.reason: BRD FR-1 does not specify per-category rates; conservative interpretation applied per guardrail policy.

ambiguities_flagged.description: Configurable point rate scope unclear (global vs per-category).

phases.name: Discovery & Integration Design
phases.description: API contract with order-management system, latency budget analysis against NFR-1's 200ms budget.

phases.name: Core Ledger Build
phases.description: Points award/redeem logic (FR-1, FR-2), ledger schema with full audit trail (NFR-3), PCI-scope boundary review (NFR-4). Duration per plan_template#template-002: 3 weeks.

phases.name: Admin & Notifications
phases.description: Admin rate-config UI (FR-5), manual grant workflow, points balance/history view (FR-3), expiry notification job (FR-4, FR-6).

phases.name: Load & Peak Testing
phases.description: Simulate peak order volume per NFR-2 (~15,000 orders/hour); verify NFR-1 latency budget under load.

risks.description: Order-management API rate limit insufficient at peak load.
risks.mitigation: Request batching or caching layer; validate in phase 4.

risks.description: PCI scope expansion if ledger design touches payment data.
risks.mitigation: Explicit architecture review checkpoint before phase 2 build, per NFR-4.

milestones.name: Integration contract signed off
milestones.target_criteria: API contract approved by order-management team.

milestones.name: Load test passing at 1.5x expected peak
milestones.target_criteria: NFR-2/NFR-1 targets met under 1.5x peak simulation.

reflection_notes.revision_from_previous: Added phase-4 (Load & Peak Testing) to cover NFR-2; added expiry notification to phase-3 to cover FR-4/FR-6; added PCI-scope risk to cover NFR-4; cited template-002 for the phase-2 duration instead of asserting it as a general fact; added a labeled assumption for the point-rate ambiguity.
